welcome.title: You talk, it keeps the notes
welcome.body: Breadcrumb is a learning companion. You talk about what you want to learn, and alongside that it builds a map of what you have covered — no note-taking, no checking in.
welcome.point1: Concepts you talk about appear on the map by themselves, and fade where you have not been
welcome.point2: Everything stays on this computer. No account, no cloud sync
welcome.point3: No leaderboards, no streaks, no progress bars
welcome.demoNote: Loads someone else's three months of learning and walks you through it. One click removes it whenever you like.

tour.label: Guided tour
tour.chatBody: All you have to do is talk. The switch above: Study mode replies guide you to think and practise; Free chat is an ordinary conversation.
tour.trailTitle: Your conversations live on the left
tour.trailBody: Titles name themselves — first concept to last. Once you rename one yourself, it is never renamed again.
tour.mapTitle: Talk for a while and this grows
tour.mapBody: These islands were pulled out of the conversations automatically; nothing here was filed by hand. Scroll up to go into one.
tour.mapEmptyBody: Every exchange you have turns what you talked about into islands here, on its own. There is nothing for you to file.
tour.mirrorTitle: Fading is what is supposed to happen
tour.mirrorBody: These two show how much you have covered and how much you would still recall. Places you have not visited fade — that is a reminder, not a mark against you. All of it is computed here and costs nothing.
tour.spendingTitle: What it costs, before you turn it on
tour.spendingBody: Every feature that costs money is on this page with its own switch, and each says roughly what one use costs before you enable it. That figure is measured, not guessed.
tour.yourTurnBody: Ask about something you actually want to understand. The map will keep up on its own.

checklist.title: Start here
checklist.demoNote: The map is showing example data right now.
checklist.tourNote: Two minutes, pointing at the actual screen. Escape leaves at any time.
